editorial.blurb: A genuine hidden gem in Wrigleyville that delivers exactly what it promises: incredibly good burritos at amazing value, made fresh with real care.
editorial.insiderTip: Skip the avocado and load up on their pickled jalapeños instead—they're the standout addition. Order a large horchata (it comes in a huge cup with no ice) and arrive around midnight when the staff handles the late-night crowd like pros.
